$comment: Registry of SAP systems this test workspace may drive through SAP GUI Scripting.
NON-SECRET metadata only. Passwords live in .claude/settings.local.json and are
referenced here by environment-variable NAME via 'passwordEnvVar'.
After editing this file run: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/sync-sap-systems.ps1
See docs/sap-gui-mcp-setup.md for the full workflow.
PRODUCTION IS DELIBERATELY ABSENT. SAP Logon Pad on this machine also holds
'NIIF - Production' (PS4) and 'TFSIN - S4 Production' (PS4). Do not add them.
If a production read-only check is ever genuinely required, add the system with
sapGui.readOnly = true AND an explicit allowedTransactions whitelist, and get the
human to confirm in writing first.
'logonDescription' MUST match the SAP Logon Pad entry name exactly - it is
the argument to sap_connect. Set readOnly=true for a look-but-don't-touch
profile, or add 'allowedTransactions': ["MM03","VA03"] to restrict which
t-codes may run. The server's own blocklist (SU01, PFCG, SE16N and other
admin tcodes) applies regardless of these settings.
Consumed by web-tests/playwright.config.ts (playwright-sap) for the
Fiori / WebGUI / UI5 lane. Same credentials block as SAP GUI above.
All three endpoints answered 401 (auth challenge) on 2026-08-16, so they
exist and require logon. Leave ignoreHttpsErrors false - if the certificate
does not validate, import the CA rather than turning verification off.
